package demo;
public class Strong extends BWebServlet {
  public void doPost(WebOp op) {
    if (!perms.has(BPermissions.ADMIN_INVOKE)) return;
    post(a, b, cx);
  }
  public void doPut(WebOp op) {
    if (!perms.has(BPermissions.OPERATOR_WRITE)) return;
    post(a, b, cx);
  }
  public void doGet(WebOp op) {
    user.check(this, BPermissions.operatorWrite);
    post(a, b, cx);
  }
  public void doDelete(WebOp op) {
    user.check(this, BPermissions.adminWrite);
    post(a, b, cx);
  }
  public void service(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res) {
    if (!perms.has(OPERATOR_INVOKE)) return;
    post(a, b, cx);
  }
}
